sections.text_helper: Section 18.3.7 "HPDMA triggers" in chapter 18 (High-performance direct memory access controller (HPDMA)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 841.
sections.section_content:
An HPDMA trigger can be assigned to an HPDMA channel x, via TRIGSEL[6:0]
inHPDMA_CXTR2, provided that TRIGPOL[1:0] defines a rising or a falling edge of the
selected trigger (TRIGPOL[1:0]=01 or TRIGPOL[1:0]=10).
[Table 90. Programmed HPDMA1 trigger]
